title: Access Control and Physical Security Management
overview: In today's security environment, it is essential for individuals and businesses to prioritize safety and security. Achieving secure environments requires a comprehensive understanding of access and egress control, risk management, physical security protocols, and resilience measures. This specialized course provides participants with the knowledge and skills needed to protect valuable assets—such as people, property, policies, procedures, and reputation—through practical exercises, live demonstrations, and interactive participation.
audience: This course is ideal for security team leaders, supervisors, and managers who want to deepen their knowledge of access and egress operations. It is also suitable for site or company managers and owners who need to establish physical security systems or teams, as well as security professionals new to the field of physical security and access control.
methodology: The course combines case studies, role plays, presentations, videos, and group exercises to enhance the learning experience.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Demonstrate a solid understanding of physical security planning.
Grasp the principles of access and egress control necessary for effective physical security management.
Conduct risk, vulnerability, and exposure assessments.
Understand internal versus external security procedures.
Apply knowledge of information technology in access control systems.
